A run that failed hands its status to the floor instead of the job
A module at the runway ceiling is reported
A document name says which repository it belongs to
A stamped date is never guessed
A withdrawal is not reversed by a later run
Two copies of a planted passage
A blocking band never rests on an absence
A tool call is a response
A document's sections read in numeric order
A band whose preconditions held yields a verdict
A per-row check cannot see a relationship between two rows
A bug file holds only what reproduced
The band table survives the run that needed it
Rostering an engine is what adds it here
A test module lists the cases it holds
A validated value cannot be replaced after construction
A recording gap is not a disagreement
The registry is declared whole, so a typo in it must fail
The register is reconciled against the run
A flag a document names is a flag something declares
Every target is its own workflow
A check that stops finding a command reports agreement
A finding without its evidence is invalid
The observation loop still records its steps
The session reports what it served
A band splits rather than growing without bound
Every observation, with its checks and its judgement
A store refreshed in part names the half left behind
A run that measured nothing is refused
A README change carries a changelog entry
A caught injection is a failure
The derived requirements files agree with the declaration
A judgement belongs to the response beside it
No engine output without a finding
Resolution credits a vendor only for what a run measured
A bound turns a hang into a failure
A citation resolves or it is not a citation
The ladder stands behind the preconditions
What a correct answer is, and commands that run
A ticket counts what it measured
The band is a parameter, not a copy
Every failure message names its class
A case records the steps after its observations
A judgement outlives the response it scored
A judged outcome does not block
Collected is not the same as run
Identifiers sit in their own block
A mistyped boundary refuses instead of deciding every band
A band adopts what the band before carried
A held finding is held once
A blocking band answers for every case it selected
A skip is not a pass
One clock, and it is UTC
The tool writes what reconciling decided
A blocker releases only on a recorded dispensation
A stated total is derived data
The band that failed is the one these counts are for
A floor claim cannot reach above itself
